reason: B gives me what I look for after losing money on a campaign: a named creator, a refund if delivery is more than three months late, an update every two weeks, a reviewer's video during launch week, and an honest note that most ratings came from people at the creator's convention table. A has a placeholder title and no refund promise. One flaw in B is that it labels the leftover $2,650 as freight and import costs without support, but it is still much more convincing.
